import re

def text_lowercase_underscore(text):
    """
    Returns True if the input string contains sequences of lowercase letters 
    joined with an underscore and false otherwise.
    
    Pattern logic: ^[a-z]+(_[a-z]+)*$
    - ^ : Start of string
    - [a-z]+ : One or more lowercase letters (first sequence)
    - (_[a-z]+)* : Zero or more repetitions of (underscore followed by one+ lowercase letters)
    - $ : End of string
    """
    
    # Compile the regex pattern for efficiency if called multiple times, 
    # though not strictly necessary for a single call.
    pattern = re.compile(r'^[a-z]+(_[a-z]+)*$')
    
    return bool(pattern.match(text))

# Test cases based on your request and edge cases
assert text_lowercase_underscore("aab_cbbbc") == True, "Test 1 failed"
print(f"'aab_cbbbc': {text_lowercase_underscore('aab_cbbbc')}") # Expected: True

assert text_lowercase_underscore("abc_def") == True, "Test 2 failed"
print(f"'abc_def': {text_lowercase_underscore('abc_def')}")       # Expected: True

assert text_lowercase_underscore("a_b_c_d") == True, "Test 3 failed"
print(f"'a_b_c_d': {text_lowercase_underscore('a_b_c_d')}")       # Expected: True

# Edge cases that should return False
assert text_lowercase_underscore("") == False, "Empty string test failed"
print(f"'' (empty): {text_lowercase_underscore('')}")               # Expected: False

assert text_lowercase_underscore("abc123_def") == False, "Contains numbers test failed"
print(f"'abc123_def': {text_lowercase_underscore('abc123_def')}")  # Expected: False

assert text_lowercase_underscore("_abc") == False, "Starts with underscore test failed"
print(f"'_abc': {text_lowercase_underscore('_abc')}")              # Expected: False (needs letters first)

assert text_lowercase_underscore("ABC_def") == False, "Contains uppercase test failed"
print(f"'ABC_def': {text_lowercase_underscore('ABC_def')}")        # Expected: False

assert text_lowercase_underscore("ab_cde_fgh_i") == True, "Longer chain test failed"
print(f"'ab_cde_fgh_i': {text_lowercase_underscore('ab_cde_fgh_i')}") 

print("\nAll assertions passed!")
